title: Buying train tickets
instructions: Bir aile tren bileti alıyor. Uzun bir diyalog; kişi sayısı, saat ve fiyatı takip et. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Hello. I'd like tickets to Oxford for two adults and two children, please.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Return. We are coming back this evening.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Adult tickets are twenty pounds and child tickets are ten pounds.

script.speaker: b
script.text: Yes. But with a family card, it's only forty-five.

script.speaker: a
script.text: Great, I have a family card. When is the next train?

script.speaker: b
script.text: At ten fifteen, from platform four. It takes one hour.

questions.feedback: İki yetişkin, iki çocuk: dört kişi.
